identity_constraints: Same real grey 2004 Toyota Land Cruiser 100 Series throughout. Match current Toyota-lettered grille, silver factory wheels, KM3 tires, ~1.5-inch OME lift, 1.25-inch Bora spacers, running boards and included Malone crossbars. No rear spoiler. frames.video_prompt:
Animate the numbered V4 frames in order as a continuous camera orbit around ONE stationary parked grey 2004 Toyota Land Cruiser 100. Start front-driver quarter, move along driver side, around rear, along passenger side, across front, and return to exact opening composition. Constant camera height, focal length and radius; smoothly reconcile small framing differences. Truck and tires do not rotate or move.

The environment is a fixed three-dimensional coastal location, not a flat backdrop. Truck nose points north along the shoreline. Ocean is east/passenger side; sandy dunes and scrub are west/driver side. Driver profile sees open ocean; rear sees ocean right and dunes left; passenger profile sees inland dunes with no ocean; front sees ocean left and dunes right. At intermediate angles, reveal the corresponding oblique shoreline. Terrain, clouds, reflections and ground shadows must change viewpoint naturally as the CAMERA travels. Keep world lighting and landforms stable; do not slide or spin the environment independently or transport the truck between locations.

Preserve the small empty black 2-inch square rear hitch receiver centered under the rear bumper. No ball mount, carrier, bikes or cargo. Keep two transverse black Malone crossbars, absent rear spoiler, TOYOTA-lettered grille, silver wheels, KM3 tires, body geometry and blank plates. Do not invent missing roof-trim location or undocumented rust. No people, text, cuts, zooms or morphing. Restore/preserve all photographed rear decals consistently across angles.

Use 01 to 02, 02 to 03, through 08 to 09 as start/end pairs where supported. Two seconds per segment gives a 16-second orbit. Final frame 09 duplicates 01 exactly. Export a silent landscape MP4. These are keyframes, not rendered continuous footage; the animator must solve spatial continuity between views.

Segment: 1 to 2. Match current photographed grille.
